items.title: Witch Profile Silhouette
items.alt: A black profile silhouette of a witch in a pointed hat holding a leafy sprig.
items.description: A flowing-haired witch in profile holds a leafy sprig near her chin. The black silhouette suits personal seasonal cards, paper crafts and journal decoration.

items.title: Witch Kitchen Coloring Illustration
items.alt: A black-and-white witch rolls dough at a table beside a star cutter and three star-shaped cookies.
items.description: A friendly witch prepares star cookies at a small kitchen table. The clear black outlines and white interiors suit personal coloring pages and classroom baking stories.

items.title: Witch Herb Drying Rack
items.alt: Five leafy herb bundles hang from a circular wooden rack with a golden crescent charm.
items.description: A suspended wooden rack holds five different leafy and flowering herb bundles. Use this botanical prop for personal fantasy journals, seasonal decorations and classroom plant vocabulary.
